Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.language

package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.language
The interfaces an expression language implements, so rule conditions and actions can be compiled and run.
  • ExpressionLanguage — A language, which creates a compiler for each rule list
  • ExpressionCompiler — Compiles one rule list's expressions and checks fact names
  • CompiledCondition and CompiledAction — Compiled expressions
  • CompileContext, EvaluationContext and ActionContext — What the engine passes to them

Rules are written in MVEL, the engine's default language.
